events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their acclaimed album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, featuring tracks like "Norwegian Wood (This Bird Has Flown)" and "In My Life".

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A true game-changer that redefined pop music. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of John Lennon today. His music and message continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th
angles.copy: The Starman himself, David Bowie, would have been 80 today. Forever a musical icon, pushing boundaries and inspiring millions.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King, Elvis Presley. He would have been 92 today, and his legacy as a global superstar remains unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the absolute guitar legend, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a true pioneer of rock.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your favourite Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th
angles.copy: It must be love! Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs, the voice of Madness and a true British icon.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young 71st
angles.copy: Come back and stay! Happy 71st birthday to the smooth vocals of Paul Young. Still got those moves.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and pop culture icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton 81st
angles.copy: Working 9 to 5 and still fabulous! Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton. A true national treasure.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow 56th
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the main man of Take That, Gary Barlow! What's your favourite track he's penned?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul icon Billy Ocean, known for hits like "Caribbean Queen" and "When the Going Gets Tough", celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean 77th
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. Still bringing the sunshine.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held in 1989, honouring legends like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction. Imagine being in that first class! Who would you have inducted?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen 55th
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the ever-charming Mark Owen! Another vital part of the Take That phenomenon.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles played their last ever live gig on a London rooftop. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins 76th
angles.copy: Sussudio! Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins. A drumming powerhouse and a vocal icon.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for romantic comedies like 'Four Weddings and a Funeral' and 'Notting Hill', celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant 67th
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the wonderfully charming Hugh Grant. Always a delight on screen, from rom-coms to more dramatic roles.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT 46th
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses' and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason 87th
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason. A true icon of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer Rick Astley, known for his 80s hits and recent resurgence, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rick Astley 61st
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up! Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley. Still rocking it.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd
angles.copy: One Love! Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity resonates more than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, behind countless hits and the iconic album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Carole King 85th
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius who shaped the sound of generations. 'Tapestry' still sounds perfect.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who tragically passed away in 2012.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the phenomenal talent of Whitney Houston today. Her voice was truly one of a kind and continues to inspire.

events.title: Take That announced their split
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their split, breaking the hearts of fans across the globe.

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago today, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Ali Campbell 68th
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine! Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40. Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran 36th
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the incredibly talented Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The Beatles' "Quiet Beatle", George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: George Harrison 84th
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the spiritual Beatle, George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. Forever in our hearts and playlists.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Roger Daltrey 83rd
angles.copy: Hope he doesn't get fooled again! Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey, the powerful voice of The Who.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw, known for 80s hits like "Wouldn't It Be Good" and "The Riddle", celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw 69th
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good... to wish Nik Kershaw a very happy 69th birthday! Still a fantastic songwriter and performer.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Martin 50th
angles.copy: It was all yellow! Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin. Still filling stadiums around the world.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Jon Bon Jovi 65th
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the rock icon Jon Bon Jovi. Still got that swagger.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Chris Rea, known for his distinctive voice and hits like "Driving Home for Christmas", would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Chris Rea 76th
angles.copy: Remembering the smooth voice of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today. His music always brings a certain warmth.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Motown legend Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Mary Wilson 83rd
angles.copy: Remembering the elegance and talent of Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today. A true Motown icon.

events.title: Michael Jackson debuts the Moonwalk
events.blurb: Michael Jackson famously performed the Moonwalk for the first time on television during the 'Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever' special on this day in 1983.

angles.name: MJ Moonwalk
angles.copy: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson unveiled the Moonwalk to the world. A truly iconic moment in music history!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan, known for his hit "Are 'Friends' Electric?", celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Numan 69th
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? Happy 69th birthday to the unique and influential Gary Numan! A true innovator.
